description: Two backward-skating zones and a stickhandling zone. Groups move to the next zone on the whistle.
steps: Boards C-cuts: Hold the boards and push backward C-cuts out with one skate, then the other.
Side, front, side: Stickhandle on your forehand side, then in front, then on your backhand side.
Backward stride: Skate backwards across the strip with C-cuts, one foot there and the other foot back.
cues: Toe in, push, bring it home.
Sit low, push to the side.

zones.name: Boards C-cuts
zones.how: Hold the boards and push backward C-cuts out with one skate, then the other. Hands shoulder-width apart; bring each skate home.
zones.cue: Toe in, push, bring it home.

zones.name: Side, front, side
zones.how: Stickhandle on your forehand side, then in front, then on your backhand side. Look up at the coach when you can.

zones.name: Backward stride
zones.how: Skate backwards across the strip with C-cuts, one foot there and the other foot back. Start facing the boards. Then alternate feet and glide.
zones.cue: Sit low, push to the side.

source.label: Hockey Canada U7 Phase II Lesson 12 · 1.5.01–1.5.02, 2.1.05
source.note: The source runs six stations. We kept C-cuts at the boards, side-front-side stickhandling and backward striding; Stick Checks, A Bug’s Life and C-cuts around the circle are left for other plans. Backward striding runs across the neutral strip instead of goal line to blue line.
